Configure current feature

  1. Configure16-slot bag and shared slot planner; implement owner-only URPGInventoryComponent and URPGEquipmentComponent snapshots. Bind WBP_Inventory/WBP_Equipment/WBP_ItemTooltip.
  2. Author registered ore/log/potion/sword/shield/hatchet examples. Item definitions, instance GUIDs, quantities and world sources remain distinct.
  3. Set15logical equipment slots, two-hand conflicts and combined-outfit compatibility mapping; missing layers never suppress valid stats.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Fill a bag with one full ore stack, one partial stack, a sword GUID and one empty slot. Move/split/merge stacks through native request and backend planner.
  2. Equip sword/shield, then request a two-handed configuration that conflicts with OffHand. Inspect stats, owner tooltips and B’s remote equipment projection.
  3. Consume one healing potion and retry its command; the receipt grants one effect/consumption path under the declared cooldown policy.
  4. Reconnect and verify item identity/slot/equipment relationships; test an item replaced in the source slot before a delayed move arrives.
Expected success
No two payloads occupy a slot, all nonstackables retain unique identity, stack limits and binding keys are preserved.
Invalid visual combination uses neutral/combined outfit fallback; equipped item stats remain correct.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Shoulders/boots/gloves or separate chest/legs overlays are not promised. Bank11 and trade19 reuse the same planner.

Expected rejection and concurrency results

SystemStimulus -> expected outcome
current-phase fixtureFull inventory, replaced GUID, stale revision, incompatible slot and two-hand conflict reject without losing either item.
current-phase fixtureUnknown appearance mapping changes only presentation; unknown required item definition quarantines the record.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

Capacity/conflict errors do not partially move gear; missing clothing keeps item stats.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
